title: AB 379 (2025-2026 Wisconsin Legislature, regular session): forms of proof of identification for voting.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) s. 5.02 (6m) (a) 5. (new): REAL ID licenses and cards from any state
(quote) An operator’s license or identification card issued by any state, as defined in P.L. 109-13, section 201 (5), that satisfies the requirements of P.L. 109-13, section 202.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
